title: Lost Horizos
description: A modern survival modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1 based on Fabric, focused on exploration, food, character upgrades, and convenient gameplay mechanics
body:
✔️ Expanded food and cooking system (Farmer's Delight, Ocean's Delight, Cooking for Blockheads)
✔️ Improved combat and character animation system (Better Combat, Player Animation Library, Trinkets)
✔️ Charming biomes, animals, and nature (Ecologics, Balm, Moonlight)
✔️ Compact and convenient exploration tools (Waystones, Explorer's Compass, Nature's Compass)
✔️ Performance and gameplay comfort (Clumps, Cloth Config, Architecture, Fabric API)
✔️ Enchanting and item progression (Enchantment Descriptions, Supplementaries, Bookshelf)
✔️ Intuitive player interface (Jade, JEI, Ender Signals)
✔️ Minimalist style with a focus on quality of life and immersion
✔️ Perfect for players who like modern Minecraft without unnecessary complications
